name: Zabdi
overview: The name Zabdi appears in Scripture as a figure connected to multiple roles and lineages. He is identified as the father of Carmi and grandfather of Achan, both from the tribe of Judah, highlighting his familial significance in Israel's history (Joshua 7:1, 17-18). Additionally, Zabdi is mentioned among the Benjamites and as a son of Asaph, indicating diverse tribal associations (1 Chronicles 8:19). Notably, a Zabdi served as a storekeeper under King David, overseeing vineyards and their produce, demonstrating faithful stewardship in the king's administration (1 Chronicles 27:27). These references collectively show Zabdi as a man linked to both family heritage and responsible service within Israel.
